title: Teach-Back Protocol Schema
description: Defines the required output structure when CORTEX distills harvested knowledge. Forces the agent to teach or build the concept to prove understanding before it is committed to STRATA memory.

concept_name.description: The primary subject or technical concept learned.

executive_summary.description: A concise, high-signal summary of the core principles, discarding fluff.

teach_back_artifact.description: The active proof of learning. Must be one of the specified types.

content.description: The actual functioning code, mermaid diagram, or JSON schema.

strata_id.description: The UUID linking this distillation to the STRATA vector memory.
